description: Personal research portfolio for medical AI, machine learning, data science, and software projects.

scripts.test: node scripts/python.cjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_cinematic_site.py -v && node scripts/python.cjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_empirical_atlas.py -v && node scripts/python.cjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_statistical_projects.py -v && node --test tests/test_service_worker.cjs

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:site
